filtering_rules: Fixed expert query: notice-type=cn-standard AND PD>=20260101. Read API pages in order until 300 unique publication numbers are kept or 20 pages are read. Require publication number N-YYYY, a non-blank title and a YYYY-MM-DD publication date. Title preference is English notice-title, then English procedure/lot title, then the lexicographically first available language. Canonical URL is the English HTML link. Drop malformed rows and exact duplicate notice ids. No subjective removal. Manifest sampling is a later beacon draw from this snapshot.
